notes: Materially competing reading on t005 *that*: rule 45's apodosis-waw sentence would hand it to s009, which is the waw opening the apodosis (וְשִׁבְעָה הַכֹּהֲנִים ... עָבְרוּ). It is retained with the `הָיָה` frame because the ASV writes it immediately after *it was so* and before the temporal *when* clause, not at the head of the apodosis — contrast JOS.6.15 and JOS.6.20, where the *that* does stand at the apodosis head and is given to the waw there. Under this reading s009 is `unrepresented` per rule 14's apodosis sentence.
s032 אַחֲרֵי is `unrepresented` rather than fused into *followed*, since the suffix keeps its own *them* — the limit rule 40 sets on that fusion.
